sources.excerpt: Soul Thrust Fuzz Unit by Greer Amps | RockBoard | PedalPedia Skip to main content LOG IN EXPLORE Greer Amps Soul Thrust Fuzz Unit LOG IN TO SUGGEST IMPROVEMENTS FUZZ Description The Greer Amps Custom Shop SOUL THRUST FUZZ UNIT is an amazing sounding fuzz. This pedal is a two transistor fuzz pedal, utilizing NOS BC107B transistors. The Soul Thrust Fuzz Unit is built on a vintage style tag strip, with amplifier grade components, including 1 watt Carbon Film resistors, full size Bourns pots, and a mix of Panasonic ECQ and Mallory 150 type capacitors. This pedal features Volume and Frequency controls. The Frequency control allows for a wide range of tone. Fuzz is controlled by the guitar's volume control--want less fuzz? Roll your guitar volume down a bit, and the level of fuzz will decrease! This pedal sounds like a cross between a Germanium FF type fuzz, and a "Bender" type fuzz...mean and aggressive, this thing will kick out the meaty grind you're looking for!
